page.layout: One page of running text. Margin notes in the right margin: "Alica speciei Zea" beside the first lines, and "Far fa-ctitium." beside the middle of the page. Running head at the top. Catchword "Sub-" at the lower right. Signature "M 3" at the lower left.

main_text.p: lumelle, Spelte seu Zea faciunt speciem.Alica speciei Zea Exi-mium autem fuisse farri a prisci's Romanis bo-norem tributum ex eo conftat, quod ipsam glo-riam a farris honore adoream vocarunt: Tanta autem erat farris copia, ut nulla provinciarum Italiam pasceret, modiusq; farris ad fingulos affes redactus erat. Numa instituit far ipsum torrere, tunc enim falubrius censebatur, unde fornacalia farris torrendi feriae instituisse fer-tur : arifta caret, interq; hiberna frumenta an-numeratur : omnium frumentorum durissi-mum, contraq; hiemes firmissimum est. Roma-nis far triticumq; vulgatissima fuisse frumenta comperio, quamuis & aliis terris communia. Varro Campanum praestantissimum appellavit. Ex omnibus autem veterum testimoniis colligere est & concludere licet, far adoreum, alicam & chondrum idem significare, & nunc quidem pro frumento peculiari, nunc pro mola, hoc est, farre ofto ex Zea confecta accipi. Far autem factitium an fuerit apud antiquos disceptatur,Far fa-ctitium. Archigenes apud Athen. l. 9. c. 45 manifeste monstrat, Romanos far ex frumento madefacto, ficcato, & in crassoribus partes diffratto, parasse: alii & quid in recentioribus, inter quos est Hiero. Mercurialis l. 2. variar. lect. contra afferunt, nullum, far aliud praeter natiuum adoreum vocatum, unquam nominasse: In his & similibus parum iunat diutius immorari, quare relinquo illu litem: nolo enim hic esse ambitiose diligens.

page.notes: The running head reads "PROROGANDA." in small capitals. The page number is printed as "18r" in an old form, read here as 181. The text is one continuous paragraph starting mid-sentence, so it is marked cont="true". "Far fa-ctitium." is split by the printed hyphen across two lines in the margin. The line "illu litem" is kept as printed. Some abbreviation marks in "q;", "&" and the sign for "-que" are copied as printed. Several words in the first lines and the marginal notes are only partly clear from the scan and may need checking.
